Question 12 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 In Excel, what does the VLOOKUP function do? Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% - Correct% - Your time 23 Avg time - The VLOOKUP function searches for a value in the first column of a range and returns a value from a specified column in the same row.
options: Look for a value in a row
Look for a value in a column
Look up a value and return a corresponding value from another column
Look for a value in a range and return its sum
